topArticle.title: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
topArticle.description: Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the elections to be boycotted.
topArticle.titleJa: パキスタン支配下のカシミール選挙は緊張を和らげるか？
topArticle.summary: パキスタン支配下のカシミールで、インド支配下のカシミールからの避難民の議席を巡る抗議活動が数週間続いた後、選挙が実施されます。一部の地元団体は選挙のボイコットを呼びかけています。

topArticle.title: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
topArticle.description: The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.
topArticle.titleJa: スーダン内戦：市民が「人間の盾」として利用される
topArticle.summary: スーダンの包囲された都市エル・オベイドでは状況が日々悪化しており、人権団体は大規模な残虐行為を警告しています。子どもたちはトラウマを抱え、学校に行くこともできません。

topArticle.title: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea, 23 missing
topArticle.description: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.
topArticle.titleJa: 南シナ海でベトナム船が沈没、23人行方不明
topArticle.summary: 南シナ海の永暑礁付近で、ベトナム船籍の貨物船が沈没し、乗組員62名のうち23名が行方不明となっています。ここは世界で最も重要かつ係争の多い海域の一つです。

topArticle.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local leaders
topArticle.description:
Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon
Indigenous leaders on the Brazilian-Peruvian border have said their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying rainforest, building roads and trafficking drugs.
Earlier this month, masked men armed with semi-automatic weapons entered homes in Apiwtxa, a village in the Kampa do Rio Amônia Indigenous territory, intimidating people and searching for targets.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: マスクを被った男たちがアマゾン地域を侵略し「人質」に、組織犯罪が急増
topArticle.summary: ブラジルとペルー国境のアマゾン地域で、組織犯罪集団が先住民コミュニティを「人質」に取り、森林破壊や麻薬密売を行っていると地元リーダーが報告。武装した男たちが家々に侵入する事件も発生。

topArticle.title: Two Russian men jailed in Angola for terrorism and spying
topArticle.description:
The men were convicted over alleged plan to stage coup and organise deadly demonstrations over fuel prices last year
Two Russian men have been found guilty by an Angolan court of terrorism and spying after being accused of planning a coup and helping to organise deadly demonstrations in the southern African country last year.
Lev Lakshtanov and Igor Ratchin were sentenced to eight and 11 years in jail respectively. They had denied the charges, claiming they were in Angola for cultural and business activities.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: アンゴラでテロとスパイ行為によりロシア人2人が投獄
topArticle.summary: アンゴラの裁判所は、昨年クーデターを計画し、デモを組織したとしてロシア人2人にテロとスパイ行為の有罪判決を下し、それぞれ8年と11年の禁固刑を言い渡した。

topArticle.title: MoD cancels army training in Kenya over powers to prosecute British soldiers
topArticle.description:
September exercise called off after Kenya raises concerns over funding and jurisdiction for criminal offences
The British army has been forced to cancel training for its troops in Kenya after the Kenyan government refused to ratify a bilateral defence agreement.
While the UK government wanted to renew the existing agreement, Kenyan lawmakers had sought changes to give local authorities greater powers to hold British soldiers accountable for any offences committed in the country.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: 英国防省、英兵訴追権限を巡りケニアでの陸軍訓練を中止
topArticle.summary: ケニア政府が二国間防衛協定の批准を拒否したため、英陸軍はケニアでの訓練中止を余儀なくされた。ケニアは英兵の犯罪行為に対する地元当局の権限強化を求めている。

topArticle.title: Health worker monitored for Ebola in London hospital after working in DRC
topArticle.description:
UK resident was evacuated from Democratic Republic of the Congo where there is an outbreak of the disease
A humanitarian worker is being monitored at a specialist hospital in London after potential exposure to the Ebola virus.
The UK resident was medically evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) where the worker had been treating patients with the disease, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) said.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: DRCでの勤務後、ロンドンの病院でエボラウイルス感染の医療従事者を監視
topArticle.summary: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ患者を治療していた英国人援助活動家が、エボラウイルスに曝露した可能性があり、ロンドンの専門病院で監視下にある。

topArticle.title: São Tomé and Príncipe heads to polls in tense presidential election
topArticle.description:
Incumbent Carlos Vila Nova hopes to defeat his former party and secure second term as independent
Voters in São Tomé and Príncipe go to the polls for a presidential election on Sunday as one of Africa’s least populous countries seeks to burnish its democratic credentials.
According to the National Election Commission, about 142,000 people are registered to vote in the tiny African state’s elections, approximately 15% of whom live in the diaspora.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: サントメ・プリンシペ、緊迫した大統領選挙へ
topArticle.summary: アフリカの小国サントメ・プリンシペで大統領選挙が行われ、現職のカルロス・ビラ・ノバ氏が独立候補として2期目を目指す。約14.2万人が有権者登録をしている。

topArticle.title: Thousands of lightning strikes trigger fresh wildfires in western Canada
topArticle.description:
At least 90 active blazes in British Columbia in what PM says is one of the country’s most intense seasons on record

How dangerous are wildfires and how can we stop them from getting worse?

Fresh wildfires have broken out in western Canada and forests continued to ⁠burn in Ontario as the country ⁠battled what the prime ​minister, Mark Carney, called one of the most intense wildfire seasons on record.
Nearly 34,000 lightning strikes over the past week led to a series of fires ⁠and evacuation orders in southern British Columbia. There were 25 evacuation orders and 90 active wildfires in the province as of Friday morning, and authorities said warming ⁠and drying conditions could cause them to grow.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: カナダ西部で数千回の落雷が新たな森林火災を引き起こす
topArticle.summary: カナダ西部で過去1週間で約3.4万回の落雷があり、ブリティッシュコロンビア州を中心に新たな森林火災が多数発生。今年度の森林火災シーズンは過去最も激しいものの一つとされている。

topArticle.title: Death toll from Guyana ferry disaster continues to rise

topArticle.titleJa: ガイアナのフェリー事故、死者数が増加の一途

topArticle.title: Online visibility becomes currency for young Cameroonians

topArticle.title: Can the Special Seats Bill deliver the gender parity Nigeria needs?

topArticle.title: Russia's businesses under strain from Ukraine's attacks on Wildberries

topArticle.title: Fire kills 10 members of same family in Peru, police say

Authorities are investigating the cause of the blaze in Lima as local media report

topArticle.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
topArticle.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
topArticle.titleJa: 70年を経てアルゼンチン裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と認定
topArticle.summary: アルゼンチンの裁判所は、70年前の「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と認定しました。被害者家族は初めて法廷で証言し、真実の解明と正義を訴えました。

topArticle.title: Smash hit: How Alex Eala's Wimbledon run made everyday Filipinos fall in love with tennis
topArticle.description: Formerly the preserve of the rich, tennis is booming in the basketball- and boxing-obsessed country.
topArticle.titleJa: 大ヒット：アレックス・エアラのウィンブルドンでの活躍が、いかにしてフィリピン人にテニスへの愛をもたらしたか
topArticle.summary: アレックス・エアラのウィンブルドンでの活躍により、フィリピンでテニス人気が急上昇。かつて富裕層のスポーツだったテニスが、バスケットボールやボクシングが盛んな同国で新たなブームを迎えている。

topArticle.title: 'It eats away at my body': The human cost of S Korea's ultra-convenient overnight deliveries
topArticle.description: Night-time deliveries are ubiquitous in hyper-connected Korea, stirring a debate about working conditions.
topArticle.titleJa: 「体が蝕まれる」：韓国の超便利な深夜配送がもたらす人的コスト
topArticle.summary: 韓国で普及している深夜配送が、労働者の健康に大きな負担を与えている。超便利なサービスが、過酷な労働条件に関する全国的な議論を巻き起こしている。

topArticle.title: China's Moonshot AI stole from Anthropic, Trump tech adviser says
topArticle.description: The allegations come as Chinese AI companies are facing increased US government scrutiny.
topArticle.titleJa: 中国のAI企業ムーンショットAIがアンソロピックから盗用、トランプ元大統領の技術顧問が発言
topArticle.summary: 中国のAI企業ムーンショットAIが、米国のアンソロピックから技術を盗用したとトランプ元大統領の技術顧問が主張。この疑惑は、中国のAI企業が米政府の監視を強めている中で浮上した。

topArticle.title: Indonesian babies were trafficked to Singapore. What happens to them now?
topArticle.description: At least 12 babies have been trafficked from Indonesia to Singapore, but what will happen to them remains unclear.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシアの赤ちゃんがシンガポールへ人身売買された。彼らは今どうなるのか？
topArticle.summary: 少なくとも12人のインドネシアの赤ちゃんがシンガポールに人身売買された事件が発生。彼らの今後の処遇についてはまだ不明な点が多く、国際的な懸念が高まっている。
